scenario: The ego vehicle changes lanes to the right on a multi-lane highway and collides with the rear of a vehicle that suddenly brakes in the target lane.

ego.behavior: The car drives forward, changes lanes to the right, and then performs emergency braking upon encountering a stopped vehicle ahead.

adversarials.behavior: The white car travels forward in the right lane, then suddenly anchors its brakes and comes to a standstill, causing a rear-end collision with the ego vehicle.
The dark-colored car in the left lane travels forward and maintains its position in the adjacent lane.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is on a multi-lane highway with a white car directly ahead in the right lane and a dark-colored car in the left adjacent lane, with buildings and greenery visible along the right roadside.
requirements_and_restrictions: The scenario involves an sudden emergency braking event in the target lane; the scenario terminates after the rear-end collision occurs.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned on the right side of the highway, mounted on a pole near the roadside.
Mounted on a pole on the right side of the highway, displaying a blue sign with white text.
